info.name: Eluno Till v1
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Eluno till API, in the order of a real bill.

**Start the server first:** `./run.sh` (API on :3000, Shopify/store-tool/terminal mock on :8787).

Run the folders top to bottom (or the whole collection in the Runner): each request saves the ids the next one needs (`cartId`, `invoiceNo`, `creditNoteNo`, `shopifyOrderId`) into collection variables.

- Money is always integer **paise** (`1869700` = ₹18,697.00).
- Invoice and credit-note numbers contain slashes (`ELU/HSR/FY26/00003`), so URLs use the URL-encoded copies `invoiceNoEnc` / `creditNoteNoEnc`.
- Errors are `{code, message, details}`; `message` is written for sales staff.
- The mock is in memory; restart the server to reset Shopify. Delete `data/till.db` to reset the till's own data (invoice series, carts, bills).

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Is the API up, and what config did it load?

request.description: Returns loaded offer and tax-rate counts and the SQLite schema version.

item.name: 1. Customer + prescription
item.description: Must 1: customer by phone (Shopify) and the prescription in force (store tool).

request.description: Phone is normalised (`90000 00005`, `+91-…`, `0…` all work). Returns the customer, billing-screen flags (priority, campaigns) and `prescription` with status `valid` | `expired` | `none_on_file` | `unavailable`, plus warnings (external Rx, axis off the 5° grid) and skipped prescriptions with reasons (future-dated, expired, another customer's).
Customer 80001012: the newest Rx (RX5018) is dated in the future and is skipped; the rest are expired, so status is `expired` with 'Book an eye test'.
Customer 80001003 has RX5999 with axis 87°/92°: valid, with warnings for the optometrist to confirm.

item.name: 2. Lens matrix + cart
item.description: Must 2: build a cart; lenses are validated against the prescription.

item.name: Lens options for the customer's Rx

request.description: All 52 lens variants (type × index × coating), each `valid` or not with `reasons`. `rx_id` is optional (defaults to the Rx in force).
Creates a cart for the customer at a store. `staffId` must be on that store's roster. `channel`: walk_in | whatsapp_booked | online_pickup (default walk_in).

Adds a pair. Either id may be omitted (frame-only, or lens-only on the customer's own frame). `rxId` is optional; the Rx in force is used. Checks: lens fits the Rx, frame in stock at this store (counting the cart), frame takes Rx lenses, product not archived.

item.name: Add pair: frame only (to remove next)

request.description: A second, frame-only pair (FR-0005), removed by the next request.
Removes a pair by its `pairRef`. Pair numbers are never reused.
The cart as saved (carts survive a restart).

item.name: 3. Offers + GST (quote)
item.description: Must 3 and 4: offers applied by their rules, then GST per line by HSN.

request.description: Per line: MRP, discount, net, GST rate, taxable value, CGST, SGST. `appliedOffers` with how each was split across lines; `offerEvaluations` gives every offer a one-line reason. For Karthik's cart: ₹1,800 off (FREE_BLUECUT_PGX + PRIORITY500 + BUNDLE300), payable ₹18,697.00.

Approver must be a store manager at this store; `reasonCode` from config/reason_codes.json (WALKOUT_SAVE, PRICE_MATCH, SERVICE_RECOVERY, LOYALTY_GOODWILL); `bps` up to 1000 (10%). It is non-stackable, so it only applies if it beats the other offers; check the quote. Audited.
See MANAGER_OVERRIDE in offerEvaluations: 5% (₹1,024.85) loses to the ₹1,800 combination.
Removes it (audited).

item.name: 4. Checkout + bills
item.description: Must 5: charge the terminal, then create the order in Shopify.

request.description: `paymentMethod`: upi | card | cash. Takes the next gapless invoice number for the store, charges the terminal (order_ref = invoice no; cash skips it), creates the Shopify order. 201 POSTED; 202 if payment is unconfirmed (NUMBERED) or Shopify has not confirmed (CHARGED_NOT_POSTED); 402 if declined (CANCELLED).
Same cart again (a retry after a Wi-Fi blip): returns the same bill. No second charge, no second Shopify order.
The bill with lines, tax, offers, payment and Shopify reference. Invoice number URL-encoded.
Continues a bill from wherever it stopped (unconfirmed payment: retries with the same order_ref; paid-not-posted: looks up then posts). Harmless on a POSTED bill.
Cancels a NUMBERED (unpaid) bill; the number stays in the series as cancelled and the cart reopens. On a paid bill this returns 409 BILL_NOT_CANCELLABLE (as here).

item.name: 5. Refunds
item.description: Must 6: full refund through Shopify's refund flow.

request.description: `reasonCode`: CHANGED_MIND | DEFECTIVE | WRONG_RX | NON_ADAPTATION. Credit note from the store's CN series; tax reversed per line as invoiced; frame restocked at the billing store, lens not restocked; money back on the terminal (or cash), then the Shopify refund against the sale. Asking again returns the same credit note.
All credit notes against the invoice.
The credit note, line by line.
Continues a refund from wherever it stopped (checks what the terminal already refunded before paying out). Harmless when POSTED.

item.name: 6. Day-end
item.description: Must 7: day-end for a store and date, from Shopify, reconciled against the till.

request.description: Bills, gross, discounts, taxable, CGST/SGST, refunds (counted on the refund date), net, split by payment method and channel, discounts by offer, invoice range, and `reconciliation` (errors vs info). `date` defaults to today (IST).
Old-POS bills: 3 bills, cash ₹14,496 (matches till_sessions_sample.json). Listed as info NOT_FROM_THIS_TILL.
No bills, but #1007's refund (billed 10-09) lands on the refund date.

item.description: What staff see when something is not allowed. Each returns {code, message, details}.

request.description: Sets up the next two error examples.
Message names the eye, value and range, and suggests the indexes that would work.
S101 works at Mantri Mall, not HSR.

item.name: Add a frame to the error cart

request.description: Sets up a small cash bill for the refund error below.
Cash skips the terminal; the bill is POSTED with chargeId null.
Unknown reason code; the message lists the valid ones. No credit note number is used.

item.name: 8. Mock read-backs (Shopify)
item.description: Look at what the till wrote, directly in the Shopify mock (:8787). Not part of the till's API.

request.description: note_attributes (invoice_no, store, channel, staff, payment method), tax_lines per line, discount_applications/allocations, Rx properties on the lens line, sale transaction, refunds.
Down by one after checkout, back after the refund.
